RCAEval contains controlled experiments. No deployment history or support tickets are supplied or synthesized.
Local ranking scores are heuristic; confidence is qualitative and is not a calibrated probability.
Offline mode uses a curated, downsampled subset of real RCAEval telemetry. Sampling can change rankings and miss brief events; no benchmark accuracy claim is made.

queries.sql: SELECT id,title,source,start_ts,end_ts,split FROM incidents WHERE id='IC-001' LIMIT 1

queries.purpose: Compare metric baseline with later observations
queries.sql:
SELECT service,name,
AVG(CASE WHEN ts<1708474950.6666667 THEN value END) AS baseline,
AVG(CASE WHEN ts>=1708475260.3333333 THEN value END) AS current,
AVG(CASE WHEN ts<1708474950.6666667 THEN value*value END) AS baseline_square,
COUNT(CASE WHEN ts<1708474950.6666667 THEN value END) AS baseline_n,
COUNT(CASE WHEN ts>=1708475260.3333333 THEN value END) AS current_n
FROM metrics WHERE incident_id='IC-001'
GROUP BY service,name ORDER BY service,name LIMIT 1000
SELECT MIN(ts) AS first_ts,MAX(ts) AS last_ts,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM metrics WHERE incident_id='IC-001'
SELECT MIN(ts) AS first_ts,MAX(ts) AS last_ts,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM logs WHERE incident_id='IC-001'
SELECT MIN(ts) AS first_ts,MAX(ts) AS last_ts,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM traces WHERE incident_id='IC-001'

queries.purpose: Critic follow-up: compare trace durations by service
queries.sql:
SELECT service,
AVG(CASE WHEN ts<1708474950.6666667 THEN duration_ms END) AS baseline_ms,
AVG(CASE WHEN ts>=1708475260.3333333 THEN duration_ms END) AS current_ms,
COUNT(CASE WHEN ts<1708474950.6666667 THEN duration_ms END) AS baseline_n,
COUNT(CASE WHEN ts>=1708475260.3333333 THEN duration_ms END) AS current_n
FROM traces WHERE incident_id='IC-001'
GROUP BY service ORDER BY current_ms DESC LIMIT 100

queries.purpose: Critic follow-up: inspect observed parent/child dependencies
queries.sql:
SELECT p.service AS caller,c.service AS callee,COUNT(*) AS spans,
AVG(c.duration_ms) AS child_mean_ms
FROM traces p JOIN traces c ON c.trace_id=p.trace_id AND c.parent_id=p.span_id
WHERE p.incident_id='IC-001' AND c.incident_id='IC-001' AND p.service<>c.service
GROUP BY p.service,c.service ORDER BY spans DESC LIMIT 80

queries.purpose: Critic follow-up: inspect service logs: checkoutservice
queries.sql:
SELECT id,ts,service,severity,message
FROM logs WHERE incident_id='IC-001' AND service='checkoutservice' AND ts>=1708475260.3333333
